rationale: The assistant correctly identified F2 as electronics overheat protection ('a safety cut-out, not a fault'), gave the right first steps (cool, touch any control), and proactively raised ventilation under the hob, which matched the hidden cause. When the customer reported the packed cutlery drawer, it said 'that's very likely the cause' with appropriate confidence, advised clearing the gap and checking Bosch installation requirements, and reserved Bosch service only for F2 in normal cooking with good ventilation. No parts were recommended, nothing was invented, and the escalation boundary matches the ground truth exactly.
